SELECT convert (Char (8),BusinessDay , 112),cast (BusinessDay as date)
FROM Calendar
WHERE cast (CurrentDate as date ) =  CAST (getdate() as date )

SELECT        CONVERT(Char(8), BusinessDay, 112) AS Expr1, CAST(BusinessDay AS date) AS Expr2
FROM            Calendar
WHERE        (CAST(CurrentDate AS date) = CAST(GETDATE() AS date))

UPDATE [dbo].[tbl_ReconEngine_Results]
SET value1 = V.value1
from [dbo].[tbl_ReconEngine_Results] a
inner join 
(select t2.ID,t2.Key0,Replace(CONCAT(t2.Value1,left(cast(replace(t2.Report2,'0 |','') as decimal(8,6))/100,8)),'00.','0.') as 'value1'
FROM [dbo].[tbl_ReconEngine_Results] t2 Where t2.ReconciliationID=28 
and t2.value1 like '%| 0' 
and t2.Value4='ZC | ZC' 
and  t2.value1 <> '0 | 0' 
and t2.ReconRunID=
(select max(id) from [ReconEngine].[dbo].[tbl_ReconEngine_ReconRun] with(nolock)
where ReconciliationID='28')
)v
on a.Id=v.Id
and a.Key0=v.Key0
where a.ReconciliationID=28
and a.ReconRunID=
(select max(id) from [ReconEngine].[dbo].[tbl_ReconEngine_ReconRun] with(nolock)
where ReconciliationID='28')
;

update [ReconEngine].[dbo].[tbl_ReconEngine_Results]
set Report2=null
where ReconciliationID='28' 
and ReconRunID =(select max(id) from [ReconEngine].[dbo].[tbl_ReconEngine_ReconRun] with(nolock)
where ReconciliationID='28')

Delete FROM [ReconEngine].[dbo].[tbl_ReconEngine_Results] 
Where ReconciliationID=28 
and Value4='ZC | ZC' 
and  value1 <> '0 | 0' 
and rtrim(replace(substring(Value1,0,CHARINDEX('|',Value1)+1),'|','')) =ltrim(substring(Value1,CHARINDEX('|',Value1)+1,len(Value1))) 
and ReconRunID=
(select max(id) from [ReconEngine].[dbo].[tbl_ReconEngine_ReconRun] with(nolock)
where ReconciliationID='28')
select MAX (ID) as ID, format(cast(max(CreateTimestamp) as Date),'yyyyMMdd') as Date  from tbl_ReconEngine_ReconRun where ReconciliationID = 28
